text: Amy - new puppy!! cockapoo, Biscuit, picked up Sat. ask how 1st wk of no sleep went
Chris @ work: Delroy (our manager) leaving end of Nov. leaving drinks Thurs after, prob the Crown
Siobhan's cat Mango poorly again - not eating, vet Tues morning for bloods. remind me to text her that evening

Aoife - interview @ Deloitte May 14, 2nd go at applying there. v nervous, has been prepping every night & her flatmate is doing mock qs w/ her. msg good luck the day before, then ask how it went afterwards. also she mentioned her sister just moved to Cork, might visit her the wk after if it goes ok
Amara - dog Rolo turns 1 on June 3rd!! she's doing pupcakes + a doggy party in the park lol
Zoe hates coriander. + nuts allergy (mild). noted for team lunch

Aurelio + Alina finally moving - Leeds, 11/2. keys that morning, van the next day, his parents driving up to help w/ the kids. she's worried re: new school for their eldest. pop round w/ a plant a week after once they've settled, and don't forget to ask Alina how the school visit goes
Dong - client pitch Fri, Tanaka Corp, biggest acct this yr. he's not sleeping. check in after
Carlos bday Oct 28. been dropping hints about bike lights / new helmet. chip in w/ Caroline?
Georgia Patel (G) - starts as team lead Mon. remind me to send a card the day before

Tanvi's mum - hip op Nov 4 in Pune. T flying out the day before, back ~2 wks after. ask how op went. her dad can't really cope alone so T might stay longer, work said fine. she's worried about the flight costs + missing her cousin's wedding the same wkend
Adaeze - vegan now / also coeliac. works @ Barclays, compliance. lives Peckham
Keisha + Joe - anniversary weekend away cancelled, Joe's dad in hospital again. text K this wk
Anders got the promotion!! senior PM from Dec 1st. drinks on him apparently
dentist 9/12 8:40am. car MOT the wk after. renew parking permit
Elena - kitten arrived yday, Pip, already shredded the curtains. her bf Louis allergic lol, antihistamines on repeat
Nina - driving test Thurs, 3rd attempt. v nervous, says she'll quit if fails. remind me to text her that morning
Svetlana Petrov (client) - contract renewal mtg Oct 30. prefers calls, hates long emails. prep deck the day before
Akira leaving Sato & Co end of month, going freelance. farewell lunch Fri 1pm - I booked the table
Rana - her brother Callum getting married Aug 9, Galway. she's MC, terrified about the speech
Fern's cat Toffee went missing Sun night - turned up Weds in neighbour's shed, skinny but fine. she cried telling me
Louis into bouldering, climbs Weds nights. wants a new chalk bag - xmas?

Adriana - redundancy mtg Mon morning. pretty shaken, 2 kids, mortgage just went up. call her that evening, must not forget. her husband Carlos says she's been up every night redoing her CV, and her boss hasn't said who else is affected. if it goes badly maybe intro her to Kate's recruiter friend the week after
Aleksander - Valencia half Dec 7. training going badly, knee niggle. wish luck day before
Delroy (boss) - my review Nov 12. need to send self-assessment the week before. ugh
Callum - new job @ Popescu Logistics, warehouse mgr. started Mon, said 1st wk = chaos
Mariam - baby #2 due 3/15! morning sickness brutal this time. her husband away a lot w/ work

Kate's dog Hector - knee op Weds. she drops him off that morning, collect the next day, then 6 wks crate rest which she's dreading bc he's a nightmare. text her Thurs pm to see how he's doing + maybe lend her the big crate. her neighbour said she'd help w/ walks once he's allowed out
shopping: dog food, bin bags, 2x bday cards, batteries
Amy + Chris - housewarming Sat 8th, new flat in Clapham. bring wine + something for the cat
Siobhan O'Brien aka Shiv - new on the team from Mon, transferred from Dublin office. knows no one in London. take her for coffee 1st wk
Aoife - interview went well! 2nd round May 21. need to ask how that one goes the day after
Zoe's budgie Kiwi died over the wknd. had him 12 yrs, she's gutted
Dong's wife expecting twins, due April. he's v anxious re: money + space
Carlos - from Valencia orig. season ticket @ Mestalla, flies back for big matches. doesn't eat fish
Caroline (HR) - new WFH policy from Jan, 2 days in office min. she says mgmt split on it
Georgia's dad retiring Dec 20 after 35 yrs at Royal Mail. party the Sat after, I'm going
Tanvi - lives in Walthamstow now, houseshare w/ 2 nurses. rescue greyhound Luna, scared of bikes

Adaeze update: her flat sale fell through (again), so moving date pushed to 6/30 from 5/31. viewing for the new place Sat morning, mortgage call Mon, solicitor the week after. sounds exhausted. her mum is staying w/ her till then which isn't helping. remind me to check in Sun after the viewing, and send her that removals guy's number
Keisha - her son starting nursery Mon. she's back @ work same day, dreading it. msg Mon evening
Joe's 40th Nov 22. Keisha planning a surprise thing @ their place - don't mention!! I'm doing the cake
Anders + Fern engaged!!! wedding prob next June. send a card
Elena - PhD viva Jan 14. scared of the external examiner. remind me 2 days before to send good luck
Nina's guinea pigs - one (Bean) has teeth probs, vet 11/5. she's on her 3rd vet bill this yr

call w/ Svetlana - off on mat leave from Feb, Rana covering the acct while she's out. set up intro call Svetlana + Rana the week before she goes. also Svetlana mentioned the board approved the new budget, so expect a bigger order Q1. she's a bit anxious about handing over mid project
Akira's daughter - piano recital Sun 3pm @ the community hall. he asked if I'd come, said yes
Rana loves Korean horror. recs: The Wailing, Train to Busan. she's never seen Alien?!
lunch w/ Fern - going part time from Jan to look after her mum (dementia, getting worse fast). struggling tbh, barely sleeping. should check in mid Nov
Louis's band - gig Dec 3 @ Moth Club, £8. buy 2 tix b4 sell out
Adriana - all sorted!! new job @ Gupta & Singh, starts June 2nd. send congrats
Aleksander knee scan back - ligament tear, no half marathon. physio from next wk, ask how 1st session goes
Delroy wants Q4 numbers by Fri. client (Mr Sato) chasing too

Callum's mum passed away last Thurs. funeral 10/29, 11am, St Mary's. send flowers the day before + go to the service. his partner said he's not really talking to anyone, so maybe a text that evening too, nothing heavy. his sister flying in from Toronto the day before, staying the wk
Mariam - her sister Amara over from Lagos 3 wks from Nov 1. they're doing Edinburgh for a few days
Kate - quit sugar, hates mushrooms. bday Feb 2, wants a 'proper' candle (Diptyque?)
Pepper - booster jabs due 12/1. book vet the wk before + flea stuff

team offsite moved to Mar 4-5, Brighton. Callum running the agenda, Tanvi doing travel. Delroy presenting on restructure the first morning - everyone nervy about it. dinner the first night, then workshops the next day. Joe says his team might be merged. I'm sorting the quiz. must tell Caroline about my dietary stuff by end of wk
Chris - the gig cancelled, venue flooded. rebooked Feb 7. he's gutted, had driven to Bristol already
good catch up w/ Amy, nothing new really. weather grim

Zoe's spaniel Bonnie had her puppies last night! 6, all healthy. she's keeping one, others go at 8 wks, so roughly mid Dec. her mum wants one but dad says no. Zoe offered me first pick - think about it this wk, ask her for photos the week after
